EncodedPieceFile.description: One piece's compressed file: its chunks back to back, with no header.

chunks.description:
`chunks[i]` = the compressed length of raw chunk `i`; **`0` means "no
compressed form, send raw"**. One entry per `ceil(piece length /
chunkBytes)` chunk; offsets are the running sum.

file.description: The file's name inside the release (`core.z`).

length.description: The file's length in bytes: the sum of `chunks`.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

Encoding1.description: Encoding 1: a `.z` file per piece, its chunks back to back, indexed here.

chunkBytes.description: Raw piece bytes per chunk: `4096` (the last chunk is short).

codec.description: For people and tools: `"deflate-raw"` (RFC 1951, preset dictionary).

EncodingEntry.description: One compressed copy of the pieces. Readers choose by `id` alone and skip an id they do not know, whatever its other keys; only `id` is required. `id: 1` is the update protocol's dictionary rule (lpc-update) and must have Encoding1's shape.

PackageRef.description: The USB package this build came from.

file.description: The package manifest's name inside the lookup (`package.json`).

image.description: The merged image the package flashes.

PieceFile.description: A file the manifest names: its name in the lookup, length, SHA-256.

file.description: The file's name inside the release (`core.bin`).

Requires.description:
What a board must have to take a build over the air. Only a prediction:
the board decides.

layout.description:
The flash layout; the board's must be **equal** (M4's code table:
`1` = layout 1).

loader.description:
The loader version; the board's must be **≥** this (M4's code table:
`1` = M2's loader, `0` = no version word).

description: The OTA release manifest, format 1 (lpc_firmware_release::OtaManifest). Readers refuse another format and ignore unknown fields and unknown encoding ids; an additive field or a new encoding keeps format 1. See the firmware-distribution ADR.

chip.description: The chip word, as the build def's `chip.name` and the board say it.

encodings.description: Compressed copies, chosen by `id`; possibly empty (raw only).

package.description: The USB package (schemaVersion 2 `package.json`) and its merged image.

requires.description: What a board must have to take this build without USB.

target.description: The target (a line of builds, e.g. `esp32c6-4mb`); opaque.

version.description:
The app version: a release (`2026.10.05-3`) or, in a local package
only, a dev version (`abc1234[-dirty-HHMMSSPT]`).

wireProto.description: The device wire protocol version, from the image's manifest core.

title: ota-manifest.json
